Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Waste Management Companies (Top 10K)

overview_description.description: Golden Cap sees an opportunity in plastic waste to create better shelters, sustain incomes of unemployed youth, and harness energy, through creating a small recycling industry with low initial capital in rural areas.  The vision is to create 24 Golden Cap ventures across Egypt to recycle 400 tons of plastic.
